name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 21 times in 6 visits over 52 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 42 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.2 days starting 2025-10-24, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 4.19 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
